0022600207.text: The Pacers (3-7, 0-5 at home) come into their 11th game of the season on a one-game losing streak, sitting 11th in the East and 3rd in the Central, 3.5 games back. They are without Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), Ben Sheppard (knee), and Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), while T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. The Mavericks (5-4, 3-2 at home) are on a one-game winning streak, sit 10th in the West and 4th in the Southwest, 2.5 games back, and are missing Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation). Indiana trails the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after a 121-105 loss in Indianapolis on October 23, and lost both meetings in the 2025-26 season.
